rulings.title: Zodiac Cycle
list: When playing a card through Zodiac Cycle, effects that increase or reduce a card's cost will still work on the new cost.
When playing a card by effect (and thus paying no cost), there's no option to use Zodiac Cycle.
Using Zodiac Cycle creates a delayed triggered skill. This skill is not a skill of the played card and will trigger even if the card loses its skills.
The delayed triggered skill will only trigger once. If the card is somehow not destroyed, it will not trigger again when you pass the turn in the future.

If the card leaves the field and comes back, the effect will not destroy it. If the card is played from the field as a Medapart, it will count as having left the field (by temporarily going to the transport zone), and the effect will not destroy it as a Medapart.

If you play multiple cards through Zodiac Cycle in the same turn, they will all trigger at the same time, and you choose the order in which they'll be destroyed. The order in which they were played does not matter.

mainText: ■ Before a non-token [Rubberobo Gang] Medabot on your field is destroyed, you may heat this card to have it get Recycle. (When it is destroyed ►Move it from your trash to your Medawatch.)

rulings.title: Medal skill
list: This is not a playable skill. Your opponent doesn't have a chance to play something in response or cancel it.
However, Recycle is a triggered skill, and your opponent will be able to cancel its play.

When a card is destroyed to pay a cost or for surpassing the field limit, no checkpoint is created to allow triggered skills to be played, so it normally happens immediately. However, this skill is not triggered, so it can work even in those cases.

rulings.title: Recycle
list: This skill will track the card as it moves from your field to your trash. If the card does not go to your trash after being destroyed or leaves your trash before the skill can be played, the effect won't work. Even if the card left the trash and went back again, it won't work.
If an opponent's card is on your field and it is destroyed, Recycle will trigger for you, but it will not work, as the card is in their trash, not in yours. The card won't go to either Medawatch.

rulings.title: Tokens
list: Tokens are cards that are only played by effects. They don't go in your initial deck.

Tokens can only exist in the transport zone (when about to be played) and on the field. If destroyed, they are removed, they don't go to the trash. If an effect tries to move it to the hand or deck, it doesn't work.
Tokens have no color and no {MC}Main Cost. Medabot tokens can't be played as Medaparts.

list: You can target the same card that is using the Support skill (if it is a Medabot).
While the effect is active, the target is considered to be "Supported", even if the card with the Support skill leaves the field or loses the skill.

rulings.title: Medal skill
list: If a card was attacking a Leader, but the attack was blocked, it is no longer attacking the Leader and the effect won't work. If a Leader blocks an attack, it becomes the attacked card and the effect will work.
If a card with Laser destroys an attacked Medabot by robattle, it will try to damage the Leader, but it won't be "attacking" it, and the effect won't work.

mainText: ■ You can heat this card ► Search the top card of your deck. If it is a Medafighter card not named "Salty", you may reveal it and spend 1{S} ► Move the card to your hand.

rulings.title: First skill
list: "Then, you may ... ►" allows you to pay a cost to play what is known as a chained skill. This will create another checkpoint, just like a triggered skill, and your opponent can cancel the play of this chained skill.

■ When another Ikki-Identity/[Tenryo Household] Medafighter on your field is destroyed, you may spend all {S} ► Move that card from your trash to your hand.

rulings.title: Second skill
list: This skills triggers for any kind of destruction: by robattle, by effect, by playing a card that surpasses the field limit, or by a Medafighter losing all its {S}Spirit.
If multiple Medafighters are destroyed at the same time, this skill will trigger multiple times, but you can still only play it once.
If this card and other Medafighters are destroyed at the same time, it will trigger for those cards, but you won't be able to play this skill because you can't pay the cost.

■ If your Leader is level 0, you can spend all {S} ► Your Leader becomes level 1. (Turn your level 1 Medal face-up and unbuild your Leader. This effect does not damage it.)

rulings.title: First skill
list: You can use this effect whether your Leader is built or not. If it was built, it becomes unbuilt (flip it and move the card under it to your trash).

Even though your Leader becomes level 1, its damage will not change. It will still need to accumulate 8 damage to become level 2, and your opponent will need to do that damage while it has {A}Armor 20.
